scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Haryana.
Applicant must possess a Family ID/Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) number.
Accidental death or permanent disability (70% or above) must be caused by a stray cattle/animal bite.
Claim must be filed within three months of the accident.
Death or disability must have occurred on or after 24 May 2023.
For death cases, assistance is paid to the head of the family or an eligible family member below 60 years, otherwise to the next eligible member.
If all family members are under 18, assistance is deferred until a member turns above 18 years.
Incorrect claims may lead to recovery of assistance with 12% annual interest.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh based on the beneficiary’s age at the time of death or permanent disability.
